Stabilize Blazor Web JS Initializers test case

## Description

Stabilizes BlazorWebJsInitializersTest.InitializersRunsModernCallbacksByDefaultWhenPresent by configuring block-webassembly-settings before navigating to the test page.

Previously, the test set the session storage value after navigation had already started. During application startup, the setting is consumed as part of the initialization flow, creating a potential race condition where the expected initializer behavior could be missed intermittently.

This change moves the WebAssembly configuration setup ahead of page navigation, ensuring the expected startup state is available before initialization begins. The update is limited to test code and does not affect product behavior or public APIs.

Fixes #68856

## Testing

- Built Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.E2ETests
- Ran BlazorWebJsInitializersTest.InitializersRunsModernCallbacksByDefaultWhenPresent successfully
- Executed the targeted test in a loop for 100 iterations with zero failures
- Verified no diagnostics, analyzer, or whitespace issues remain

The original intermittent failure could not be reproduced locally.
